claim.claim-text: 1. A washing machine (100) comprising:

a control panel (110) including a course selection dial (241), a course display (251) and a dryer control button (221) configured to obtain a user input for switching from a washer control mode to a dryer control mode; a communication device (180) configured to communicate with a drying machine (300); and a controller (190) connected to the control panel (110) and the communication device (180), wherein the controller (190) is configured to:

display (1140), on the course display (251), a plurality of washing courses in order according to a rotation of the course selection dial (241) in the washer control mode, in response to obtaining (1125) the user input through the dryer control button (221), switch from the washer control mode to the dryer control mode, display (1185), on the course display (251), a plurality of drying courses in order according to the rotation of the course selection dial (241) in the dryer control mode, transmit (1190) information corresponding to a drying course displayed on the course display (251) in the dryer control mode to the drying machine (300) through the communication device (180).
2. The washing machine according to claim 1, wherein:

the control panel (110) further comprises a drying operation button (231) configured to obtain a user input for starting an operation of the drying machine (300), and wherein the controller (190) is further configured to transmit a control command to start the drying operation to the drying machine (300) through the communication device (180) in response to obtaining the user input through the drying operation button (231).

3. The washing machine according to claim 1, wherein the controller (190) is further configured to turn off the washing machine (100) in response to obtaining a user input through a washer power button (211) in the dryer control mode.
4. The washing machine according to claim 1, wherein the controller (190) is further configured to:

in response to obtaining a user input through the dryer control button (221), identify (1040) whether the washing machine (100) is connected to the drying machine (300), and display the drying course on the course display (251) based on a connection of the washing machine (100) to the drying machine (300).

5. The washing machine according to claim 4, wherein the controller (190) is further configured to display a washing course on the course display (251) in response to obtaining a user input for switching to the washer control mode through the control panel (110) while the drying course is displayed on the course display (251).

6. The washing machine according to claim 1, wherein the control panel (110) further comprises a remote control button (281) and a setting display (291), and wherein the controller (190) is further configured to display on the setting display (291) whether a remote control of the washing machine (100) is activated in response to a user input through the remote control button (281).

7. A method of controlling a washing machine, the washing machine (100) comprising a control panel (110) including a course selection dial (241), a course display (251), a dryer control button (221), a communication device (180) and a controller (190), the method comprising:

displaying (1140), on the course display, a plurality of washing courses in order according to a rotation of the course selection dial in a washer control mode; in response to obtaining (1125) a user input through the dryer control button, switching from the washer control mode to a dryer control mode, displaying (1185), on the course display, a plurality of drying courses in order according to the rotation of the course selection dial in the dryer control mode, transmitting (1190) information corresponding to a drying course displayed on the course display in the dryer control mode to a drying machine through the communication device.
8. The method according to claim 7, wherein:
the control panel further comprises a drying operation button, and the method further comprises:

obtaining (1230), through the drying operation button, a user input for starting an operation of the drying machine, and transmitting (1235), using the controller, a control command to start the drying operation to the drying machine through the communication device in response to obtaining the user input through the operation button.

9. The method according to claim 7, further comprising: turning off, using the controller, the washing machine in response to obtaining a user input through a washer power button in the dryer control mode.
10. The method according to claim 7, further comprising:

in response to obtaining (1040) a user input through the dryer control button, identifying (1045) whether the washing machine is connected to the drying machine, and displaying (1070, 1075) the drying course on the course display based on a connection of the washing machine to the drying machine.

11. The method according to claim 10, further comprising: displaying (1030, 1035) a washing course on the course display in response to obtaining (1080) a user input for switching to the washer control mode through the control panel while the drying course is displayed on the course display.
12. The method according to claim 7, wherein:

the control panel further comprises a remote control button and a stetting display, and the method further comprises: displaying on the setting display whether a remote control of the washing machine is activated in response to a user input through the remote control button.
